summary: Two-hand Arms in Battle Stance: Mortal Strike, Slam on its cooldown, Overpower off dodges and Bloodthrill procs, with Rend kept up and Weaponmaster sword procs. It is the Arms spec's Level 60 preset, about 13% behind dual wield Fury.
rotation: With 20 sec left, Recklessness ready and under 25 Rage: swap to Berserker Stance and stay
Death Wish held for the last 36 sec, Recklessness in the last 20 sec; racials with Death Wish
Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20 sec; Bloodrage under 10 Rage
Slam from 20 Rage (15 sec cooldown with Improved Slam), outside execute
Rend kept up outside execute; then Execute
Heroic Strike from 70 Rage, Hamstring filler from 20 Rage (outside execute)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 30 Strength and 16 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Synthetic Phase 1 gear on Forever's physical budget (ids 991001-991018)
Late Forever rulings cost (Undead 180 s): Ahn'Qiraj ranks out -14.2, Deep Wounds no crit -7.2
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Deep Wounds ticks can't crit (client attribute); Deep Wounds tick timer restarting on each crit is a modelling choice
Crit Rage bonus assumed white hits only; Heroic Strike swings count for Unbridled Wrath (open assumptions)
One +2% crit elixir a character: whether Ferocity stacks with Mongoose in game is open; a second crit elixir (Grizzly) would add 10.9
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece (+36 AP vs Humanoids) not counted (would add 8.4 at Undead 180 s)
The audit found Recklessness never cast and Rage capping; fixed with the stance swap and Hamstring filler (811.9 -> 868.7 on earlier gear)
Booming Voice (5/5) does nothing because the raid has Battle Shout
Arms in Berserker Stance with Whirlwind all fight was 10% behind
